title: Kissinger among the first CIC officers in Oberammergau

tellings.quote: Henry Kissinger was one of the first officers to occupy the barracks there in 1945.

plain: In 1945 Henry Kissinger was one of the first officers to move into the barracks at Oberammergau in Bavaria, Germany, serving with the US Army's Counter Intelligence Corps. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode asking whether Kissinger ran a program to recover crashed UFOs. He brings it up to place Kissinger in intelligence work early on.
